aboutPage.title: Seren Lottery — complete project description
intro: Seren Lottery is built to change lotteries forever: winners are picked by blockchain, not by people.
Every draw is transparent, verifiable, and permanently recorded on-chain.

threeSteps.title: 🎟️ Step 1: Buy a ticket
threeSteps.text: One ticket costs 30 POL. No registration or KYC needed — connect wallet and join.
points: 3 POL (10%) is technical fee for VRF and gas.

threeSteps.title: ⏳ Step 2: Wait for draw
threeSteps.text: Round runs until jackpot target from homepage is reached.
points: The team starts draw once pool is filled.
Each start is a public transaction visible on Polygonscan.

threeSteps.title: 🏆 Step 3: Winner selection
threeSteps.text: Contract requests randomness from Chainlink VRF and picks winner mathematically.
points: Result cannot be predicted or manipulated.

fairness.title: 🔮 Randomness is external
fairness.text: Chainlink VRF is independent; owner cannot choose winner.

fairness.title: 👁️ Every action is visible
fairness.text: You can inspect who launched draw, when, ticket amount, and winner.

fairness.title: 💰 Economics discourage cheating
fairness.text: A larger pool means stronger growth and fees for project sustainability.

aboutPage.verificationTitle: How to verify on your own
verify: Open Polygonscan with the contract address.
Check Read Contract values: round, ticketsCount, prizePool, open.
Open Events and inspect draw history.

faq.q: What if owner does not start draw?
faq.a: Funds stay in contract, but project economics motivate regular draws.
Some limits are configurable, but ticket price and commission are fixed in code.

faq.q: What if draw starts right after I buy?
faq.a: You are in immediately; odds are equal for all tickets of this round.
